thread:
maria: quick follow-up from the RFC — i'm worried about shipping the edge->central abuse signature forwarding as-is. two big concerns: PII leak surface and extra tail latency. thoughts?

tim: agreed. main tradeoff is detection fidelity vs privacy & perf. central adjudication makes tuning easier but adds a network hop and broadens data access.

alice: can we do a hashed fingerprint first? keep full payload only for flagged events. that reduces PII & bandwidth while keeping central correlation.

ben: hashed sig helps but increases collision false positives for multi-tenant signals. we should add namespace+salt per region: `sig = H(salt || tenant || raw)` so collisions are low.

maria: +1 to salted hashes. also need TTL/provenance — edge should include a short proof header so central knows when/where it saw the event.

ben: example header sketch:
```
X-Abuse-Sig: sha256=ab12...;
X-Abuse-Region: us-west-2;
X-Abuse-TTL: 60;
X-Abuse-Proof: edge=slot42
```

tim: ETA: if central only sees hashes, some mitigation actions (eg automated rate punish) may be too aggressive. Do we allow local edge mitigation to act on high-confidence local signals and central to reconcile later?

alice: yes — prefer local soft-degrades (suppress, 429 with Retry-After) on edges when local heuristics fire. central can later escalate to account-level blocks after aggregation.

maria: operationally, we need a clear contract: edge decisions = best-effort, reversible. central decisions = authoritative. Also need an audit log link in the headers for repro.

security-bot: alert: test run saw 1200 sigs/min from staging-edge-3. sample id: 6f2c9. raw payload retained in secure vault for 7d (access: sec+oncall).

tim: rollout plan proposal: implement hashed sig + region salt, edge local soft-degrade, central aggregate & flag. canary to 5% edges in us-west for 48h, enable verbose telemetry only on canary.

ben: metrics we need in console: per-tenant sig-rate, hash-collision-rate, local-degrade-rate, central-escalation-lag. add trace id on header for troubleshooting.

alice: config toggle: `forward_full_payload: enterprise_only` default false. legal asked for opt-in for full payload export.

maria: decision summary: 1) start with salted hashed signatures + TTL & provenance headers; 2) edge-local reversible soft-degrades; 3) central aggregation authoritative for account actions; 4) enterprise opt-in for full payload; 5) canary rollout 5%/48h; 6) telemetry hooks as ben listed.

tim: :thumbsup: gonna write short RFC follow-up with interfaces and rollout steps (will ping infra for canary slots).

alice: i'll add the observability dashboard mockups and collision sampling job.

ben: i'll draft the header spec and salt rotation plan (90d rotation window + replay tolerance).

maria: thanks — please tag me on PRs. if we can get the follow-up RFC out today we can align with oncall for canary. :rocket:

security-bot: note: remember to list data retention in the RFC (staging vs prod) and who can access raw samples.
